item.title: Charter committee hears familiar critiques, fresh questions at Diamond Lakes
item.description: Augusta’s Charter Review Committee heard some familiar comments as well as a few new ones at a Tuesday town hall meeting. The post Charter committee hears familiar critiques, fresh questions at Diamond Lakes appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Kentucky defeats South Carolina 72-63 in men’s basketball
item.description: Kentucky seized control with a decisive first-half run and closed strong down the stretch to defeat South Carolina 72-63 on Tuesday night at Colonial Life Arena. The post Kentucky defeats South Carolina 72-63 in men’s basketball appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Teen, 16, arrested in deadly Augusta armed robbery shooting
item.description: The Richmond County Sheriff’s Office has arrested a 16-year-old in connection with a fatal shooting earlier this month on Winesap Way. The post Teen, 16, arrested in deadly Augusta armed robbery shooting appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Blythe care home owner arrested on felony exploitation charge
item.description: The owner of a personal care home in Blythe has been arrested and charged with a felony after an investigation into alleged exploitation and intimidation of vulnerable adults. The post Blythe care home owner arrested on felony exploitation charge appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Jury seated, opening statements near in Tripp murder trial
item.description: Opening statements are expected to start Thursday in the trial of Leon and Tanya Tripps, accused of killing 16-year-old Janell Carwell. The post Jury seated, opening statements near in Tripp murder trial appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Laney High student assaults employee in hallway, campus held in place for an hour
item.description: A student at Lucy C. Laney High School physically assaulted an employee in one of the school's hallways Wednesday. The post Laney High student assaults employee in hallway, campus held in place for an hour appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: CES Committee approves canceling Masters Week meeting
item.description: The Columbia County Community and Emergency Services (CES) Committee approved the recommendation to cancel an upcoming Columbia County Board of Commissioners meeting. The post CES Committee approves canceling Masters Week meeting appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Jordan Laxton set to lead Augusta Christian Schools into next era
item.description: Augusta Christian Schools has named Jordan Laxton as its new Head of Schools, bringing fresh leadership to a Christian institution that has served the CSRA for nearly seventy years. item.title: Columbia County Development Authority to reimburse county for White Oak
item.description: The Economic Development Authority of Columbia County (EDACC) is paying back Columbia County for the cost to develop the White Oak property. The post Columbia County Development Authority to reimburse county for White Oak appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Augusta moves to settle in fatal 2023 crash involving deputy
item.description: The Augusta Commission agreed Tuesday to pay $700,000 to settle claims by a woman whose husband was killed in a 2023 wreck with a Richmond County Sheriff’s deputy. The post Augusta moves to settle in fatal 2023 crash involving deputy appeared first on The Augusta Press.
